assignment.reason: The actual final statutory and pending-case reasoning has nine direct joins, including Stone-Zsela, with a lawful nine-Justice quorum. The approved conditional direction therefore requires him to deliver every part of this lead. Coverage includes the enacted nonabrogation holding, the independent intervention/default/payment predicates and the application of existing pending-case and independent-adjudication principles; no portion relies only on judgment agreement. The full Plaut rule is accurately stated as existing law, without attributing renewed endorsement of its earlier underlying rationale to its prior dissenters. All nine are otherwise eligible and all nine fall within the ordinary balance pool, but the actual conditional direction determines authorship rather than an invented superiority claim over the lower-count Scalia, Thomas or Breyer. The direction leaves no uncovered portion needing a separate Section 8 assignment. The signed lead counts once for Stone-Zsela. The actual preceding-topology snapshot is `../freeze/OT_2003CHUNK8_ASSIGNMENT_ROEDER.json`.
assignment.form: One signed opinion after full merits briefing resolves the integrated immunity, independent-bar and pending-case questions. All nine directly join every present holding and its judgment; the account of Plaut accurately states existing law and applies its pending-case boundary without creating a new unanimous endorsement of its earlier finality rationale. A divided lead and a merely repetitive separate opinion are unnecessary. The case-specific conditional writing direction covers the complete actual reasoning supported by at least five Justices including Stone-Zsela; the exact final compatibility is stated in the Chief section.
